Summary: SMB legaltech startup building searchable knowledge base for contracts and customer support docs. Inbound from blog post about embeddings + reranking. Primarily interested in hosted API (self-serve) to avoid infra overhead. Wants 2-week POC.

Requirements / constraints:
- Target workload: end-user question answering + contextual RAG inside product help and support desk (web UI).
- Data size: ~200k documents (mix of short clauses + long contracts). Expect incremental daily adds (~1k/day).
- Latency/throughput: aim for <300ms query-to-top-result for web UX; willingness to accept slightly higher tail for rerank step.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage, tight budget. Looking at unit economics for avg 10k queries/month, spike to 50k.
- Model preferences: prefer small/medium open models for embeddings and reranker to control cost; open to Redwood-curated models.
- Retrieval strategy: hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval then lightweight re-ranking. Evaluating Pinecone today; asked about recommended vector DB partners and sample architecture.
- Security: SSO (SAML) required before putting POC in front of internal testers; audit logs needed for compliance. US data residency preferred.

What we ran through on call:
- Demoed creating an embedding and a rerank request using hosted API. Showed streaming generation and token-level cost visibility in console.
- Discussed batching/async embeddings for initial index build to reduce cost. Suggested prefix caching for common queries.
- Talked through fallback options when model capacity is limited (route to smaller/cheaper model).

Quotes / paraphrases from prospect:
- "We need cheap, predictable costs more than bleeding-edge LLM quality right now."
- "If you can show how this plugs into our Pinecone stack with minimal code, we can run the POC this week."

Technical asks outstanding:
- Sample code for Pinecone + Redwood hosted embeddings + reranking (node/python).
- Clear estimate for monthly cost at 10k/50k queries including embedding refreshes and rerank token spend.
- SSO/SAML test plan and how to enable for trial orgs.

Next step (short): send tailored onboarding pack, POC checklist, and a 60% cost-savings example using batching + local caching. Owner to follow up w/ credit code for 2-week POC.
